thread:
liz: FYI tenant 'delta-labs' reporting SCIM failures after last night's RBAC rename + key rewrap. Getting mixed 403s and 500s, then our rate limiter kicks in :grimacing:
omar: On it. Short log snippet shows authz deny for svc-delta-scim then a KMS NotFound for the new key id in the same trace.
liz: That matches onboarding timeline: rename scim.manage -> scim.write at 6285007000, then infra rewrapped key at 6285007200. Might be a race where principals weren't backfilled before rewrap.
dev-bot: infra: rewrap completed by infra@ops at 6285007200 alias=redwood-scim-prod -> new-key-id :white_check_mark:
audit-bot: audit: rbac rename event 6285006980 actor=rbac-service change=scim.manage->scim.write rollout=100% (link:https://audit.internal/e/6285006980)
omar: Immediate mitigations: 1) enable compatibility mapping for scim.manage principals (feature flag) 2) temporarily add svc-delta-scim to KMS allowlist for new-key-id 3) clear tenant token bucket so retries don't cause 429s.
liz: Agreed. Also we should add a post-rotate smoke test that validates SCIM write with the principal context. I'll add to runbook.
omar: Done: compatibility mapping toggled, KMS allowlist patched, quota cleared. Error rate dropped to near zero.
liz: Follow-ups: backfill identity store entries to grant scim.write, add rollout checklist to coordinate RBAC renames with key operations, and add an audit alert when both events happen within 5m. Owner: @omar.
omar: Will file a short incident note and link traces. Closing in 30m if green.
